# istio_telemetry (Resource)

Manages an Istio Telemetry resource. Telemetry configures how metrics, traces, and access logs are generated for workloads.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "istio_telemetry" "default" {
  manifest = jsonencode({
    apiVersion = "telemetry.istio.io/v1"
    kind       = "Telemetry"
    metadata = {
      name      = "default"
      namespace = "istio-system"
    }
    spec = {
      tracing = [
        {
          randomSamplingPercentage = 10.0
          providers = [
            { name = "otel" }
          ]
        }
      ]
      metrics = [
        {
          providers = [
            { name = "prometheus" }
          ]
        }
      ]
      accessLogging = [
        {
          providers = [
            { name = "envoy" }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `manifest` (String) Full Telemetry manifest as a JSON string. Must include `apiVersion`, `kind`, `metadata.name`, and `metadata.namespace`. The `apiVersion` in the manifest determines which API version is used (e.g. `telemetry.istio.io/v1` or an older version like `v1beta1`). Sensitive fields (tokens, keys, passwords, etc.) are redacted to "(redacted)" in state after read.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the format `namespace/name` (or `name` for cluster-scoped resources).

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
